notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Marvin using Metalworker's ability by tapping it, revealing an artifact card from your hand and adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
